cases.title: Busy day
cases.summary: Volatility and taker flow at the high end of the observed range.
cases.description: Every product moves and trades as on the busiest of the three real days, including TELLURIUM's 13 jumps on day 0.
references: QuantiFi Prices and Trades EDA reports (day-level ranges)

cases.title: Regular day
cases.summary: Every product follows its calibrated behaviour.
cases.description: Day 1 continues days -2 to 0 with central calibrated parameters. This is the case the generator's fidelity gate checks against the real data.
references: QuantiFi Prices and Trades EDA reports

cases.title: GOLDEN_PEARLS keeps falling
cases.summary: GOLDEN_PEARLS steps down two or three times.
cases.description: The open question from the Prices report resolved one way: the downward steps speed up. WHITE and BLACK absorb each step as on the real days.

cases.title: Black swan crash
cases.summary: A market-wide crash of 5-15% in seconds, with spreads blowing out and IV spiking, then a partial recovery.
cases.description: At a random time every diffusive product drops 5-15% within 5-30 ticks, all together. The market maker widens and thins for 500-1,500 ticks, volatility doubles or triples, voucher IV jumps, and 20-50% of the drop recovers over the following 1,000-3,000 ticks.

cases.title: TELLURIUM storm
cases.summary: TELLURIUM jumps 2.5x as often and twice as far as ever observed.
cases.description: About 25 jumps of up to about 600, against 8-13 jumps of up to 300 on the real days.
